text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform and often perform better, while cross-platform apps save time and money by working on both iOS and Android. Responsive design is also essential, so apps look good on different screen sizes. After development, apps must be published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where they need to meet certain rules. Finally, performance matters a lot: users expect fast, smooth apps that do not crash. Good testing helps developers improve performance before release.
